transcript.text: All orders are in 2025, timestamps look like the timezone-aware timestamp already aligns to the -08:00 offset consistently for order_ts date extraction. Now compute gross revenue (sum of amount, no discount subtraction) for completed orders in 2025, amount is in cents.

args.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS gross_cents, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND year(order_ts) = 2025

transcript.text:
Gross revenue (sum of `amount`, no discount subtraction) for completed orders in calendar year 2025 in memory.bench.orders = 143,060,383 cents = $1,430,603.83.

This matches the "settlement total" style definition (gross = sum of amount, completed orders only) but extended to the full calendar year 2025 rather than just Q4, and amounts are stored in cents per the dataset's `unit: cents` property, so I converted to dollars.
